title: ProjectPulse – Project Intake & Delivery Management System
summary: A modern Power Platform solution for managing project intake, approvals, delivery tracking, team capacity, and portfolio reporting in one centralized system.
impact: Centralized project requests, approvals, and delivery tracking into one structured platform.
Automated approval routing, reminders, and escalation workflows using Power Automate.
Improved management visibility through real-time dashboards and Power BI reporting.
Enabled better prioritization by tracking project status, budget, team capacity, and delivery health.
Reduced manual coordination between requesters, managers, PMO teams, and delivery owners.
